confirm_help: 请确认电脑上的校验码与这里一致，再继续。
Check that the number on your computer matches before continuing.
done_title: 已确认，回到网站继续吧
done_body: 网站会继续完成登录。首次使用时，可在网站选择绑定已有账号或创建新账号。
The website will complete sign-in. On your first visit, choose an existing account or create a new one there.
native_intro: 已有网站账号，登录后可查看预约、积分和时长。
Sign in with your website account to view bookings, points and studio time.
password_login: Sign in and connect this WeChat
wechat_login: 使用已绑定的微信登录
wechat_create: 新用户，使用微信创建账号
New here? Create an account with WeChat
website_account: 已有微信网站账号但未设置密码？请先在网站登录，再用自有小程序二维码绑定当前微信。
Already use WeChat on the website without a password? Sign in there first, then connect this WeChat using the mini program QR code.
forgot: 找回账号 / 忘记密码
recovery_help: 请在 pindoupuppy.com 的登录入口选择“找回账号 / 忘记密码”。
Select Recover account / Forgot password on pindoupuppy.com.
miniapp_not_configured: 自有小程序登录正在准备中，请先使用网站现有登录方式。
Mini program sign-in is being prepared. Use the current website sign-in options.
miniapp_provider_unavailable: 暂时无法连接微信，请稍后再试。
Temporarily unable to connect to WeChat. Please retry.
miniapp_code_expired: 微信登录凭证已失效，请重新尝试。
WeChat sign-in expired. Please try again.
miniapp_session_expired: 本次微信验证已过期，请重新尝试。
This WeChat verification expired. Please try again.
miniapp_account_required: 请先登录已有账号或创建新账号。
Sign in to an existing account or create a new one.
miniapp_other_scanner: 这张二维码已由其他微信扫码，请在网站刷新后重试。
Another WeChat account scanned this code. Refresh it on the website.
miniapp_confirmation_mismatch: 校验码不一致，请在网站刷新二维码后重试。
The verification numbers do not match. Refresh the QR code on the website.
wechat_flow_expired: 二维码已失效，请在网站刷新后重新扫码。
The QR code expired. Refresh it on the website and scan again.
wechat_flow_used: 这次登录请求已处理，请在网站重新开始。
This sign-in request was already handled. Start again on the website.
wechat_binding_conflict: 微信或网站账号已有其他绑定，请使用原账号继续。
This WeChat or website account is already connected elsewhere. Continue with the original account.
account_password_invalid: 邮箱或密码不正确，请检查后重试。
Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.
account_rate_limited: 尝试次数较多，请稍后再试。
Too many attempts. Please try again later.
generic_error: 暂时未能完成，请稍后重试。
Could not complete this action. Please try again.
